Working at RAD

RAD employs over 600 people, the majority of whom work in Israel at the company’s three sites located in Tel Aviv, Jerusalem, and Be'er Sheva, with the rest working in offices around the world.

We emphasize a stable and growing company culture and encourage professional development for our people. Our Vice Presidents of R&D and Operations, for example, started their careers as juniors within the company. Dedicated and talented employees who want to grow and learn from the best can find a warm and professional home at RAD, with access to training, enrichment courses, and opportunities to move between roles within the company.

What Makes Our Employees Proud?

Technology Innovation

We pride ourselves on being at the forefront of technology innovation, providing our employees with access to the latest tools and resources to enhance their work experience.

Togetherness

At RAD, we value togetherness and prioritize building a strong team, which fosters a collaborative and supportive work environment.

Making an Impact

Our impact-driven approach ensures that our employees are making a difference, as RAD products are being used all over the world.
